steps: Register for the CastingWords Workshop (currently US-only for new registrations) and complete onboarding.
Claim transcription tasks matched to your grade level.
Transcribe to spec and self-review before submitting - grades 0-4 are unpaid.
Get paid via PayPal on the scheduled Friday transfer once you hold at least $1 and one week of membership.
timing: Official: 'Scheduled transfers every Friday at 10:00 AM Pacific' via PayPal only; $1 minimum balance and one week of Workshop membership required.
